topics.description: The FBI has taken over the investigation into the fatal ICE shooting in Minneapolis, causing tension between state and federal officials. Minnesota Governor Walz has expressed concerns about the fairness of the probe. The shooting has sparked a heated debate about ICE's actions and the Trump administration's response.

The Trump administration has frozen billions in child care funds to five Democrat-led states, including Minnesota, alleging fraud. This move has drawn bipartisan criticism, with some lawmakers accusing the administration of politicizing social services.
